items: The one live PASS proves nothing
The three-methods case passed only because it expected zero blocks and no session ran at all.
Ignore that result; the rerun is the evidence.
verify_tools.py fails check A16 on this machine
The check tries to uninstall house-rules@aj-house-rules, which is not installed here. The merge did not cause it.
Run it on a machine with the plugin installed, or leave it as a known local failure.
